Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)
Enhances: Berserk
Option Slots: 0 (Cyberware Enhancement)

Berserk Operating System. Berserk becomes Borgware for Maximum Humanity Loss, needs no Action to trigger, and runs 12 seconds (4 Rounds). Each activation costs a non-FBC user with no Cyberspine 1d6 Humanity, and they shoot at -4 on Ranged Attacks while it burns. HP damage taken is halved, rounding up, and each of these costs only half of a ROF 2 Action: Grab, Human Shield, Get Up, Equip or Drop Shield, Stabilize on yourself, Use an Object, and stowing a weapon, clearing a jam, putting yourself out while On Fire, activating an item or a piece of cyberware. Brawling and Martial Arts Aimed Shots run at ROF 2 for anyone who couldn't manage that already. When it drops, the user gets 5 HP back, never past their maximum, and the next hour is cooldown unless they pay 3 Humanity per consecutive activation inside it (3, then 6, then 9).

Foundry notes:

  • Every Operating System is incompatible with every other Operating System and with the base cyberware it is for: none of them can be installed while another OS, or that OS's own base cyberware, is anywhere in the user's body or in a worn apparatus they're connected to. The sheet doesn't enforce that.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Operating Systems > Berserk Operating Systems).
